visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female flight attendant in a dark green uniform with a vibrant yellow, red, and green scarf smiles warmly at the camera. She stands in the aisle of an airplane cabin with bright, white lighting. (2) She leans down to talk to a male passenger in a black shirt. He points to his eye and face, seemingly correcting her. Her expression shifts from a smile to exaggerated shock with her hands on her cheeks. (3) The camera shows extreme close-ups of her face, highlighting smudged eyeliner and lipstick. Colored text overlays identify these areas. (4) A close-up shows hands holding a makeup cushion compact and using a cotton swab to dab product. The swab is then used to wipe the smudged makeup on the flight attendant's face. (5) Further close-ups show a makeup brush applying powder to her cheek and a lipstick wand applying pink gloss to her lips. (6) The flight attendant returns to the passenger aisle, looking polished. She greets the passenger again, and he responds with a smile. (7) A blooper scene shows both characters laughing uncontrollably while seated in the cabin, breaking their professional personas.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, medium-tempo acoustic guitar BGM begins with a light rhythmic beat. A female voice speaks with a bright, high-pitched professional tone. (2) A transition 'whoosh' sounds as the scene shifts. A male voice speaks in a conversational, moderate pitch. A high-pitched 'ding' SFX punctuates the female's surprised reaction. (3) An electronic 'shimmer' or 'sparkle' SFX plays during the close-ups of makeup details. (4) A male narrator's voice enters with a calm, instructional tone. Subtle 'tapping' and 'swiping' sounds simulate makeup application. (5) The female voice returns to her professional greeting script. The BGM remains consistent and energetic. (6) The track cuts to a burst of loud, high-arousal laughter from both the male and female speakers, signaling a blooper. The male voice mocks the previous scene with a teasing tone.
